catalogs.completeness_basis: Majors list on the 'University Catalog 2026-2027' Undergraduate page (stored only in the discovery run). Its 273 entries, mostly 'Major (BS): X Concentration', collapse to 101 major+award programs, the same count as the reviewed record. The two spellings of Parks, Recreation(,) and Tourism Management (BS) count as one major. Excluded: AAS entries and first-year, exploratory and transfer entries. Counted though unsure: the 2 Mathematics Education double majors, and Biological Engineering (BS) separately from Biological, Agricultural, and Ecological Engineering (BS). All 97 verified records are list pages and cover 70 of the 101. 61 majors are matched on the bare-major page. 9 are matched through concentration records because the list has no bare-major page for them: Agricultural Education, Agroecology & Sustainable Food Systems, Crop and Soil Sciences, Food Science, Horticultural Science, Leadership in the Public Sector (Distance Education page), Mathematics Education, Natural Resources and Science Education.
